method: Every256RGB pixel of a unique supplied bitmap is observed twice at training ticks and independently at reserved fourth-decision original ticks; conflicting complete bitmaps are rejected. Registration uses known terrain only and retains all equally best origins.
uncertainties: A mosaic is full pixel coverage across genuine images, not a claim that a single frame shows the entire tile.
Native camera is not exposed; image-derived registration candidates and adjustments remain explicit.
Visually identical semantic tile IDs are aliases; hidden block content and collision timing are not inferred from bitmap identity.
Partial8px art is separate and never creates an arbitrary collision rectangle.
